services.desc: Included in all fishing charters: all fishing gear, terminal tackle and bait, fish cleaning, arrangements for processing and shipping fish, non-alcoholic drinks, water and snacks. Recommended items for you to bring: rainwear, waterproof footwear, hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, warm clothing for layering; camera, extra batteries. At this time I can only offer catch and release for halibut fishing. If you are looking for the Alaska experience and want to try your hand at catching an Alaska barn door halibut we can help you with that.
